turns.text: Absolutely, buddy! Remember when you were little and you didn't want to go to the playground because it was new and scary? That's kind of how I think going out with friends can feel sometimes, but it's important to remember that it's usually a lot of fun once you get there. It's okay to feel nervous, but try to take a deep breath, remember the good times you've had, and give it a try! In psychology, we call this overcoming avoidance behaviors.
